higgs-lilith.summary: Pinned external reduced-coupling likelihood and same-call supplied SM reference.

_integration.qualification: Requires installed-runtime API and database qualification before scientific acceptance.
_integration.handoff: Register through the shared registry lane with mode, manifest and curation. Bind doctor group lilith; found values are package version and database-list SHA256. Sector validator is ravel.physics.higgstools_bridge.validate_bundle. Both comparison results need the same comparison_input_sha256 from the sector/reference pair, normalized measurement IDs and explicit SM-relative delta_chi2.

task.input: path to closed JSON input document

input_contract.pins: bundle, sm_bundle, database and doctor_report are path/sha256 objects relative to the input document.
input_contract.database: Pinned metadata includes version, sha256 of list_file, list_file pin, files pins, mass_window_gev and complete canonical measurement_ids. Supply the database applicability source with its member pins; infer no mass window or measurement aliases.
input_contract.runtime: python pin, version and complete source/dependency files pins; required isolated interpreter lives in .venv-lilith. Native imports outside these pins fail closed.
input_contract.mapping: Complete couplings map from tt, bb, cc, tautau, mumu, WW, ZZ, gg, gammagamma, Zgamma to sector coupling keys; branching_ratios maps invisible and undetected to explicit BR keys. precision is LO or BEST-QCD; coupling_normalization is SM amplitude. Only real CP-even neutral scalars are supported.
input_contract.execution: Plan and admit through ordinary science lifecycle and method decision; run only in its live supervised science worker. Child time/RAM ceilings remain inside that admission.
input_contract.comparison: cross_engine(signals, likelihood) uses max(1, 0.15*abs(primary delta_chi2)); signed SM-relative differences and both unique measurement lists are retained. A finding requires scientific interpretation, never automatic acceptance.
